reviews.x: I don't usually review a product (unless I'm especially ticked off). However the reviews on this are mixed so I thought I would help swing them to the positive. It comes with no instructions, so I looked to Amazon for help with that. I did not sand off the top coat of my gel/French manicure. I just put it on the nails of my left hand and gave it about 8 to 10 minutes. Then I used polish remover to get rid of the blue gel. You do need a metal cuticle pusher to scrape off the rest of the polish. I

reviews.t: Works good, need a few coats
reviews.x: This stuff works much better than having to sit with aluminum foil on your nails. I use dip powder and find that I do have to do multiple coats of this to completely get it off. I’ll let it soak in for about 10 minutes, scrape off what I can, and put on another coat. Usually two coats gets everything off but sometimes I need to do 3.
Product is crap. Don’t buy it. I filed the clear top coat off and applied the remover... wait 15 minutes. Nothing happened. Repeated this 3 separate times... It’s crap.  Returned.

reviews.t: Not what you expect but worth it
reviews.x: I think it’s good for the money you pay. I wear dip and after I apply the product I wait 5 minutes and used a steel nail tool and scrap it off. It does take about 3 times to do it but it doesn’t not damage my nails and it beats having to do the cotton ball with smelly acetone. I only gave it three stars because in the videos of advertising it is not at all how the stuff looks or works. It’s blue and goopy. I’ll buy again. And I’ll use to remove my own nails and not have the salons do it, everyti

I purchased this product to remove gel polish from my nails.  I wasn't expecting the thick blue goo that came out of the bottle, but thought I'd give it a try.  I filed the top layer of  gloss from my nails per the recs (There are no instructions included btw, but I came back to the ones listed on the product description to buy).  I applied a thick coat to my nails, then reapplied, then waited...15 minutes...20 minutes...30 minutes and NOTHING!  Nothing happened.  Polish still in place.  Luckily

This didn’t work and it literally made my natural nails curl inward and pinch my finger. This product was dangerous. I used it as directed although it comes with no instructions. Within 2 min I felt an odd pressure sensation on my nails and by the third minute wiped it off. It took about an hour for my nail to return to normal. I will never ever use this again. Beware!
Ordered the three pack. One came perfectly fine. 2 bottles had the lids opened a bit and all the product came out onto the bag.
Takes about 25 minutes and multiple applications to remove it unlike the listed 5 minutes to work. For the price it is ok.

reviews.t: It works, but not quickly as described
reviews.x: Easier than foils, but it takes about 10 minutes to work on a two color coat gel manicure.

reviews.t: Magic is the perfect name for it!
reviews.x: This is truly Magic!! Now that we have salons reopening after COVID closed everything, I was thinking about going back to the salon simply because the removal process for gel polish is a nightmare. Not anymore! When I polish there are at least five coats. This amazing product took off all of it in less than 10 minutes with only two applications and no harsh grinding. Honestly, one application probably would have worked if I had left it on a little bit longer. I was dumbfounded... The gel polish

reviews.t: This works! Seriously. (And I’m a noob)
reviews.x: This works! Not sure what the other reviewers are doing.. but it worked for me... pretty awesome! I didn’t even file my top coat off to really put it to the test. After five minutes my gel polish had bubbled up and away from my nail... it was easily scraped off with a plastic cuticle pusher I have.. The only negative I noticed was that my nail seemed to be pretty dry afterwards but acetone does the same thing- and worse! I will DEFINITELY be using this instead of acetone from now on. It’s pretty

This stuff is incredibly thick.  It is sometimes hard to get it to stick to the brush, but once you get it applied to your nails, it works.  I had to use it two times to remove dip powder, but it did work.  I applied the gel, waited 10 minutes, scraped off everything that was looses, and repeated the process.  Easier to spend 10 minutes without soaking or wearing clips on my nails.  It is more expensive than using acetone, but it's a nice alternative.

reviews.t: Not sure if this product arrived in a correct consistency!
reviews.x: First of all, product arrived almost solidified jelly...it looked extremely dried out. Second, you have to attempt to apply this in a very thick layer. Maybe because of its consistency that it arrived in. Not sure. It’s a lot of product to use, no wonder u get 3 bottles for so cheap. Product isn’t clear, it’s blue. Is that right? Not satisfied with this product at all.

reviews.t: Product is VERY thick, almost dried out
reviews.x: All three bottles of this product are almost unusably thick. Does it work? Yes. Does it work as quickly as advertised? No. It can easily take over half an hour to remove gels with this stuff. It does much less damage than acetone and and scraping, but it's still labor-intensive.  I would be curious to hear if others received a more robust product.

reviews.t: NO FUNCIONA y no lo recomiendo.
reviews.x: No funciona y estoy muy decepcionada, lo compre para facilitar mi trabajo y solo me hizo perder el tiempo ya que no me ayudo a remover el esmalte de gel seguí  las instrucciones y hasta busque videos en U2 para saber cómo funciona y  NO FUNCIONA y definitivamente no lo recomiendo, no malgasten su dinero.

reviews.t: Waste of money. Waste of time.
reviews.x: This didn’t work at all. My bottles came with lumpy, dry stuff inside and wasn’t easy to get out of the bottle or in the nails. Once it was on, it didn’t work at all. I tried several times to make sure I was doing it correctly and it’s just one of those products that doesn’t work.

If you are tiered of using Acetones on yore nails, look no mere this is by far the best gel remover ever. so easy to use. I use 3 coats to take off my 4 layer gel nail polish, its no messy and it just glides off. Worth every penny and will definitely repurchase wen I am finished.

This product absolutely does not work. No matter how long I let it sit, there was no flaking like you see in the advertisement. Super disappointed. I wish I would have seen the numerous YouTube videos showing how this product does not work before wasting my time and money on it.

The product was thick and chunky and didn't spread evenly, it didn't even come out of the bottle smoothly or brush on smoothly. It was like it when bad or dried out or something, all 3 bottles were the same. Will not buy again and threw it away because it didn't work either.

It didn’t work as described , I put it on my nails and verses removing the nail polish it harden my nails to the point that they bended. My nails were long and I had no choice but to cut them off since this bended them so bad that they were carving into my skin .

Product is crap. Arrived sealed in a plastic bag but all three bottles were dried out. The goo inside was thick and blue, not colorless. I tried thinning with acetone and it doesn’t work. Applied to one hand anyway without a hint of removing anything. Don’t buy!

Product came thick and sticky not sure how it's supposed to be but did not work in 5 minutes by any means. I was wondering if it was the weather because it came by mail in it got too cold and it ruined it that's way then give it less stars

It does work. You have to apply it a few times to totally remove the gel polish but eventually you will get there. I like that there is no harsh smells.  Overall, the product is effective and I would buy this again.

reviews.t: gummy and hard to get out of bottle
reviews.x: The bottle did not seem to have much product in it.  It was gummy, and I was definitely scrapping the bottom of the bottle that I just opened. It did work, but I had to try so hard to get it out and goop it on.

Doesn’t work. I do gel and dip nails. Was super excited to try this stuff and it literally did nothing. Just made me have to also remove this along with the dip color I have on. Don’t waste your money.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the product works, though often requiring multiple applications or longer than advertised.
Several reviewers report the product did not work at all for them.
Reviewers frequently note the product is very thick, sometimes arriving dried out or solidified.
Some reviewers complain it takes much longer than the advertised time, often 10-30 minutes or multiple rounds.
A few reviewers mention missing instructions and packaging problems.
